I will try to use some chemical fertilizer, but not too much because it is costly and sometimes arrives late, and I will also use manure if I have enough from home. I prefer improved seed for maize if I can get it through the cooperative or market, and I will rely mostly on family work, with a little hired labor only if needed at planting or weeding. I do not plan to irrigate because I depend on the rains, and I will not use pesticide or herbicide unless there is a serious problem.
